smoke_failure: 2026-05-26 — badge rendered in FOUR places; first pass only fixed site #1. Sites #2, #3, #4 showed stale 'Gemini CLI' after an errored model switch.
root_cause: Sites #2 (_ResumableSessionRow) and #3 (_TranscriptHeader) called _AgentKindBadge(agentId: session.agentId) without passing providerId — provider→agent-kind mapping was never applied. Site #4 (_BubbleHeader / _CollapsedBubble in agent_bubble_overlay.dart) used entry.agentId from a stale AgentBubbleEntry and looked up AgentConfig via context.read (no subscription), without using providerId at all. Additionally AgentBubbleEntry did not carry providerId, so even a watch would have missed it.
